  "Surgical excision is the first-line management for melanoma.",
  "When melanoma is suspected, the entire lesion should be completely excised.",
  "The excision margin should be narrow, between 1 and 3 millimetres.",
  "The excision is performed to obtain a histological diagnosis.",
  "For primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness, surgical excision with histologically negative margins is recommended.",
  "For melanoma in situ, surgical excision with histologically negative margins is recommended.",
  "The excision margins should be determined based on tumor thickness.",
